samples.summary: User-facing docs not updated for the new list controls / interactive checkboxes
samples.evidence: The Formatting Toolbar table (lines 49-55) still lists only Bold/Italic/Strikethrough/Link/Table, and "What the Preview Renders" (line 67) still describes task lists as merely rendering as checkboxes, with no mention that they are now clickable or that a line-leading `[ ]` auto-completes to `- [ ] `. Precedent is mixed (the image-upload button is also absent from that table), so this may be intentionally batched.

samples.summary: Dropping `label: true` also removes the checkbox/text label association for read-only previews
samples.evidence: `md.use(taskLists, { enabled: true })` removes the previous `label: true`. The justification (a label double-reports the tick) applies only to interactive previews; read-only mounts, which keep disabled checkboxes and gain nothing from the delegated handler, silently lose their `<label>` association. A per-instance render option, or re-adding labels when `onToggleTask` is absent, would keep the read-only rendering unchanged — this is a rendering change the issue did not ask for.

samples.summary: Block-level list state is stuffed into `NoteInlineFormats`, whose name and doc now contradict its contents
samples.evidence: `NoteInlineFormats` gains `list`, `canIndent`, `canOutdent` — block-level state — while remaining named "Inline" and exported under that name from `packages/notes/src/index.ts`. The task plan (docs/tasks/active/20260822-notes-list-controls-todo.md step 3) does direct this to keep one subscription, but a renamed/composed type (e.g. `NoteFormatState { inline, list }`) would keep the public API honest.

samples.summary: Bare-`[ ]` conversion fires only on a typed space, so other completions of the criterion's shape are not covered
samples.evidence: Acceptance criterion 1 says typing `[ ]` (or `[x]`) at the start of a line converts to a checkbox item without typing the `-`. The handler only triggers on the space character immediately after `]`; e.g. `[ ]` followed by Enter, or `[ ]` completed by an auto-closing bracket then non-space input, leaves plain text. The task doc's Non-goals only exempt pasted boxes, not these typed paths.
